The CloudEvents attributes ce_specversion, ce_id, ce_type, ce_source, ce_subject and ce_time are envelope headers of the CloudEvents 1.0 binary mode. They are not fields of the Logical Data Model or Data Classification and are not rows of this table (DOR-RWB-PLT-TE006-CON-7).

Contract shape (GAP-1416): the library is one published artifact with a major version. It exposes three interfaces, UUID OutboxWriter.publish, ConsumeResult OutboxConsumer.consume and boolean IdempotencyGuard.firstTime, with the exceptions set out in the legacy RWB-TE-006 section 12. Its artifact name and publication channel are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1416). Events carry CloudEvents 1.0 attributes and the caseId record key (BR2, BR4). The retry ladder is 1 min, 10 min and 1 h, then the dead-letter topic with one alert and the replay tool (BR5). Case-step events, tasks and decision records stay with the owning service (BR6).
